name: 4a-mods
description: 4A-Mods: Claude Code mods by 4AM. Cache Keeper shows costs as plan-limit percent instead of dollars; Toggles switches plugins, skills and MCP servers and shows what each costs in context; Plan Keeper ticks plan files from the task list; Prompt Translate turns your draft into English with one button; Savvy Progress (by johnnyvizz) shows a live panel of every subagent with its model, context, cost and time. Filetree (by Kurt Buhler) shows a file tree of what Claude reads and edits. Connector Trim shortens big JSON results of MCP connectors by code and saves the full result to a file.

plugins.name: cache-keeper
plugins.description: Keeps a big chat's prompt cache warm, warns before an expensive cold restart, shows every local chat on one board (/board), and hands a big chat off to a fresh one (/handoff), with its five steps on a card above the prompt

plugins.name: plugin-toggles
plugins.description: One pane (/toggles) to switch skills On, Name, User or Off, plugins, MCP servers and mods On or Off, see what each costs in context, and save the set as a profile

plugins.name: plan-keeper
plugins.description: Writes a plan from a task list of three or more steps, ticks a plan file's checkbox items once the task-list step of the same text is done, shows the plan's progress in a band and a pane (/plan-keeper), and tells Claude when a task list ends with plan items open

plugins.name: prompt-translate
plugins.description: An EN button above the prompt (or /translate) that has Haiku translate your draft into English in place, without sending it

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: A live panel of every subagent (/agents-info): model, effort, progress, context, estimated cost and time, plus a progress bar for savvy-flow that counts the steps of up to three subagents. By johnnyvizz, MIT, copied from johnnyvizz/claude-kit

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: An IDE-style file tree pane (/filetree): the files Claude reads, writes and commits, with git status, diffs, search, previews and guarded paths. By Kurt Buhler, MIT, copied from data-goblin/claude-code-filetree

plugins.name: connector-trim
plugins.description: Trims big JSON results of MCP connectors by code and saves the full result, as returned, to a file (/connector-trim). Redacts nothing; a helper model is called only if you turn use_helper on
